# DotForLife

> DotForLife (dotforlife.com) is a free bilingual Arabic/English platform for families in Saudi Arabia and the GCC. It offers free calculators and practical guides for everyday family decisions: visiting Makkah and Madinah, family finance and zakat, home buying, and family health.

## Makkah and Madinah
- [Makkah and Madinah hub](https://dotforlife.com/makkah/): practical guides and trip tools for visitors
- [Makkah trip planner](https://dotforlife.com/makkah/tools/makkah-trip-planner/)
- [Madinah trip planner](https://dotforlife.com/makkah/tools/madinah-trip-planner/)
- [Makkah to Madinah planner](https://dotforlife.com/makkah/tools/makkah-to-madinah-planner/)
- [Hotel decision tool](https://dotforlife.com/makkah/tools/hotel-decision/)
- [Planner for families with elderly members](https://dotforlife.com/makkah/tools/family-elderly-planner/)
- [Return to Hotel card](https://dotforlife.com/tools/return-to-hotel): an offline card a visitor shows a driver to get back to their hotel
- [Cave of Hira visit guide](https://dotforlife.com/islamic-hajj-umrah/cave-of-hira-story-en)
- [Umrah with kids](https://dotforlife.com/islamic-hajj-umrah/umrah-with-kids-en)

## Prayer and Islamic tools
